Regional Football Pathways | Preparation guidance reviewed 18 October 2026
Recommended template, not a universal club requirement. Follow the receiving club’s instructions.
Replace bracketed text; delete irrelevant fields. Do not send this uncompleted template.

Suggested highlights duration: 3–5 minutes, strongest examples first.
Use recent match evidence; identify the player and preserve the decision's context.
Avoid long introductions, effects, repeated replays and changes to playback speed.
This duration is guidance, not a UK club rule.

POSITION COVERAGE
Goalkeeper: positioning, handling, crosses, distribution, decisions outside area.
Centre-back: covering, positioning, duels, progressing possession.
Full-back: one-on-one defending, recovery, support, delivery.
Midfielder: scanning, receiving under pressure, passing choices, transitions.
Forward/winger: movement, combinations, creation, pressing, finishing decisions.
